keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Words or phrases to find in the notice title or description, case- and accent-insensitive ("software", "road maintenance", "laptops"). Title matches rank first. Notices are in their original language (TED titles also come in English). Empty = all notices.

keywordMatch.title: Keyword match
keywordMatch.description: any: a notice matches one of the keywords. all: it must match every keyword.

countries.title: Countries
countries.description: 2-letter ISO country codes of the buying authority ("DE", "FR", "US", "GB", "AU"). Empty = worldwide.

openOnly.title: Open for bids only
openOnly.description: Only calls for tender (and prior notices) whose submission deadline is still in the future at run time.

noticeTypes.title: Notice types
noticeTypes.description: planning (prior information, sources sought), tender (calls for tender, solicitations), award (contract award notices), contract (contracts signed or modified), cancellation, other. Empty = all.

cpvCodes.title: CPV codes (prefixes)
cpvCodes.description: EU Common Procurement Vocabulary codes or prefixes: "72" = IT services, "45" = construction work, "33" = medical equipment. A notice matches when one of its CPV codes starts with one of these. Notices without CPV codes (SAM.gov, most Latin American platforms) are excluded when this is set.

naicsCodes.title: NAICS codes (prefixes)
naicsCodes.description: US NAICS codes or prefixes ("5415" = computer systems design). Only SAM.gov notices carry NAICS codes.

buyers.title: Buyers
buyers.description: Text to find in the buying authority's name ("ministry of defence", "NHS", "Stadt München"). Empty = any buyer.

minValue.title: Minimum value
minValue.description: Only notices with a stated value (estimated value for tenders, awarded value for awards) of at least this amount, in the notice's own currency. Notices without a value are excluded when this is set.

maxValue.title: Maximum value
maxValue.description: Only notices with a stated value of at most this amount, in the notice's own currency.

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: Only notices whose value is in this ISO currency ("EUR", "USD", "GBP"). Use it with minimum/maximum value to compare like with like.

publishedWithinDays.title: Published within (days)
publishedWithinDays.description: Only notices published in the last N days. The index keeps 90 days of notices plus older calls that are still open.

deadlineAfter.title: Deadline on or after
deadlineAfter.description: Only notices whose submission deadline is on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD), e.g. to leave enough time to prepare a bid.

sources.title: Sources
sources.description: Only these sources: ted, sam, uk-fts, uk-cf, or a national platform ocds-<country> (ocds-au, ocds-de, ocds-nl, ocds-br, ...). Empty = all.

sortBy.title: Sort by
sortBy.description: relevance (keyword matches in the title first), newest (publication date), deadline (soonest deadline first) or value (largest first). Default: relevance with keywords, else deadline when open only, else newest.

sinceLastRun.title: Only notices not delivered before
sinceLastRun.description: Remembers the notices this Actor delivered for the same filters (in a named key-value store in your Apify account) and returns only notices added to the index since, so a daily schedule gets each notice once and is never charged twice.

maxResults.title: Max results
maxResults.description: Maximum number of notices to deliver (and charge for) in this run.
